ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Weapons Expanded - Coilguns
ModMetaData.author: Oskar Potocki, AveryTheKitty, Taranchuk, Sokyran
ModMetaData.description:
The Vanilla Weapons Expanded 2 - Coilguns mod remakes the original submodule by introducing high-tier Spacer-tech mass drivers: the Gauss Rifle, Revolver, and Lance, all featuring absolute armor penetration. These weapons, unlocked via the "Portable Mass Drivers" research project, feature a signature high-power mode that enables penetrating multiple targets, though at the cost of doubled warm-up time and damage reduction per target hit.
If you’re one of the happy owners of Odyssey DLC, customization is expanded with six new weapon traits: Inertial core, Bypass relay, Overdrawn Coils, Ionized sabots, Hypercapacitors, and Inverted rail tuning.
Projectile behavior is improved to prevent friendly fire, which can be fully disabled in storyteller settings. Finally, the weapons now boast brand new visual effects, including a high-power charging animation, debris, and hard-to-clean bullet holes at the point of impact.
Vanilla Weapons Expanded is part of a series of mods expanding on everyday life on the Rimworld. When paired together with a brand new Vanilla Apparel Expanded and Vanilla Armours Expanded, you can bring something to your game that will keep you interested in it for days.
